text:
elaine: FYI — ACME asked for a per-route throughput addon with softcaps + surge exemptions. they want predictive pricing and a 30-day pilot. do we treat as a Priority-Lane addon or fold into Enterprise tier?

mike_sales: +1 on needing a clear addon. customer will pay for guaranteed per-route throughput, but they also asked for contractual surge exemptions for product launches.

sunil_eng: need to know expected qps and KV cache behaviour. per-route isolation is doable but increases tail latency unless routed to dedicated pools.

anita_pm: launch criteria question — we should require: pilot success (latency < 150ms p95), billing shape agreed, and legal SLA signoff. if it's an addon, we can ship faster.

mike_sales: addon gets revenue quicker. enterprise bundle increases sales friction. ACME prefers < 2 week onboarding window.

oliver_finance: pricing framing: two options — 1) fixed monthly capacity token + overage at higher rate, or 2) tiered slab per-route. option 1 easier to forecast.

legal_bot: we need to scope surge exemptions carefully. propose: exemptions limited to three discrete launch events per 12 months, with notification 48h prior and extra cost if sustained >72h.

sunil_eng: operational note: we'll need a routing policy + fallback variant if dedicated capacity exhausted. fallback must be documented in contract.

elaine: ok actionable: anita, draft two product signals (addon vs bundle) with launch checklist. oliver, sketch pricing. legal_bot, draft clause above. sunil, cost delta for dedicated pools and fallback. mike, confirm ACME tolerance for pilot SLOs.

anita_pm: will do. quick mock of addon config we can show sales:

```
addon: {
  name: "priority_lane",
  per_route_qps: 1000,
  burst_window: "5m",
  softcap_tokens: 500000,
  surge_exemptions: 3_per_year
}
```

mike_sales: ACME said acceptable to 1st draft, wants pricing banding though.

oliver_finance: draft pricing: base capacity $8k/mo for 500k tokens + $0.012/token overage, or slab: $8k for up to 3 routes, $12k for up to 10 routes.

legal_bot: add clause: "Provider may throttle beyond 72 hours of sustained surge at pre-agreed rate; customer may request temporary dedicated capacity with 48h notice."

sunil_eng: dev/ops ask: can we support 48h live provisioning for dedicated pools? requires automation work (~2 sprint effort).

anita_pm: decision needed: fast-follow MVP as addon (minimal contract) vs integrated enterprise feature (requires infra & legal). recommend MVP addon pilot with ACME to validate demand and telemetry.

elaine: agreed. next steps: anita to produce a one-pager + pilot SLOs by EOD Thu, oliver to provide pricing matrix, legal_bot to produce SLA clause draft, sunil provide rough infra estimate. mike will confirm ACME pilot acceptance. :thumbsup:

mike_sales: pinging ACME now. thanks everyone.
